audit_scope: Read-only independent parsing of existing raw evidence; no model, service, dependency or git execution. Only this new audit JSON is written.

stage_02_fixed_screen.interpretation: One observed price per role. Buyer price equals this fixture reserve; seller price is below its 120 budget. No optimal dominance or general win-rate claim.

facts.controlled_execution: Original peer application code with real Codex gpt-6-sol/low transport; not original Haiku/Ollama/Groq providers. CLI prompt preservation and HTTP message preservation checked against request logs.
facts.native_pr289_model: Original PR289 harness does not specify --model and discards successful CLI stderr; its native underlying model/reasoning cannot be established from these saved execution artifacts. Current user config is not execution-time proof.

concurrent_failure.interpretation: Buyer HTTP read timeout while the seller was queued; retained seller trace has no admission or CLI execution evidence. This is not a recorded model-generation timeout or exhausted 90-second queue deadline. Other concurrent inference contributes queue pressure; FIFO correctness or scheduler starvation is not inferred.

transport_errors.error: RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected without sending a response.

limits: All listed screens are lamp/budget120, n=1 per role; no statistical dominance, seven-agent ranking, or generalization claim.
Controlled provider substitutions are distinct from native-provider results, even with unchanged peer source files.
Shared HTTP transport evidence is global only; exact per-match model-call attribution is not asserted.
harness_request before queue admission is an attempt record, not proof a model process ran.
Native PR289 successful CLI model identity is not retained; original/default is not a pinned model.
baseline-native-screen lacks contemporaneous runner SHA in its manifest/summary. Other runner versions are reported separately and not silently unified.
A2A version audit covers POST RPC; readiness Agent Card GETs intentionally lack the version header.
One-purchase finding covers retained RPC observations in these bounded runs, not hidden external inventory/financial effects.
Source hash recheck covers manifest participant source files with logs/venvs/git/cache excluded; source commits are taken from manifests, not independently revalidated against git in this audit.
